name: Should I repair or replace my roof after wind damage?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my roof after wind damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace depends on the extent and severity of the wind damage. Minor localized damage, like a few missing shingles, can often be repaired. However, widespread damage affecting a significant portion of the roof, or if your roof is older, might necessitate a full replacement for long-term structural integrity. We provide a thorough assessment to help you understand the scope of damage and recommend the most cost-effective and durable solution for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor, localized wind damage; replace for widespread damage or older roofs. We assess the damage to recommend the best solution.
